title: Cobblemon - Blender Default Cube
description: A mod that adds the Blender Default Cube to Cobblemon
body:
Addon to add the Blender Default Cube to Cobblemon.

# How to install
1. Open your minecraft folder
2. Paste the zip into your resourcepacks folder
3. Go back to your minecraft foler
4. Go to saves > (your world) > datapacks
5. paste it there too
